description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Shipwreck Dowser
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
